exports.description: List of exported directories, each specifying the path, client(s), and access options

client.description: Client specification: single hostname/IP, network/netmask (e.g., 192.168.1.0/24), or wildcard (e.g., *.example.com)

options.description: List of NFS export options (e.g., ro, rw, sync, async, no_subtree_check, no_root_squash, secure)
